auth_scope: read:org (classic PAT) or fine-grained token with organization Members read-only permission

pagination.exhaustion_method: per_page=100; follow the Link rel="next" header until absent, on both the members and outside_collaborators endpoints

rate_limits: 5000 requests/hour per authenticated principal (REST core limit)
history_caveats: STATE only: current membership snapshot cannot prove when a member was removed

GitHub logins are platform-local and profile email is often private: the identity join to HRIS/IdP identities requires the SAML/SCIM external-identity mapping, and local (non-SSO) accounts may have no IdP counterpart at all
